industry.why: Double Underweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the United States consumer surveys fell again (University of Michigan 46.3 preliminary October, down 1.8; Conference Board 81.9 in September, down 6.7; Goldman Sachs 19 Oct), consumer discretionary lagged with technology and communication services in the week's rotation (Jefferies, 17 Oct), and the European consumer was again not read, so the row rests on the US reading and on the regime. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, D prior, the largest industry in the universe at 138 stocks. Counter-case: Retail physical reads B and Online retail A on relative strength, Hotels C, which is where cheap good businesses accumulate, and a double notch on 138 stocks shuts bottom-up work out of the Lists; the exceptions are carried at sector level (H.3 Neutral).

sector.why: Underweight, carried unchanged, with the fuel leg stronger. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Brent $111 is the airlines' largest cost, the US consumer surveys fell again, and no source spoke to airlines. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: F now, F prior. Held D, not F, because no Pool name sits here and the new evidence is a price, not a read on the group. Counter-case: capacity discipline and fourteen stocks already derated.

geography.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Brent $111 and energy leading the week; Norway is where the energy hedge is listed (Equinor, Aker BP, Var Energi, Odfjell Drilling, Subsea 7, TGS in the Pool). Oslo's own performance was not re-read this week. Relative strength is not graded by country. Counter-case: this double counts the Energy rows for most of the 46 Norwegian stocks; back to C if Brent falls under $85 or Oslo's leadership reverses for four weeks.
